text:
Sam C.: quick smoke: brought up Mistral-7B on quantized Q6_k across A100 vs H100 in eu-west/us-west. wanted a tiny sanity check before we schedule a longer run. results pasted below.

Anya P.: nice, plz include batch=1/4 and both prefill+decode numbers. also region tags.

Sam C.: yep. fresh run: bs=1/bs=4, token length=512 (prefill 512 then decode 128), kv-cache cold. model=q6_k-mistral7b, kernels: fast-attn-v2 + qkv-fused-int8 when available else fp16-decode.

Sam C.: results (p50/p95 in ms, tok/sec measured during decode stage, cost estimate $/1M tokens using our reserved hourly rates):
```
region | gpu  | bs | prefill p50 / p95 (ms) | decode p50 / p95 (ms) | tok/s | $/1M tokens
US-W  | H100 | 1  | 210 / 360             | 165 / 290            | 1520  | $1.18
US-W  | A100 | 1  | 330 / 540             | 240 / 420            | 880   | $0.82
EU-W  | H100 | 1  | 250 / 480             | 190 / 370            | 1400  | $1.25
EU-W  | A100 | 1  | 360 / 700             | 280 / 560            | 760   | $0.86
US-W  | H100 | 4  | 420 / 790             | 320 / 620            | 5800  | $0.95
US-W  | A100 | 4  | 640 / 1180            | 480 / 1000           | 3300  | $0.68
```

Anya P.: interesting: H100 p50 decode ~30% faster at bs=1, and scaling at bs=4 gives better tok/s. cost per 1M still higher but effective cost/token at bs=4 narrows.

Leo W.: did you hit any kernel fallbacks in eu-west? numbers look a bit worse for H100 there.

Sam C.: yes — EU-W H100 nodes were on a slightly older driver that fell back to slower matmul kernel for the qkv-fusion path under sustained prefill >200ms; deploy-bot logged a warning: "kernel-fallback:qkv-fused->fp16-matmul". I gated longer runs until infra updates.

Talia R.: any quality regressions from Q6_k quant? eval set: 1k prompts with BLEU-ish and LM-specific metric.

Sam C.: quick eval: Q6_k vs fp16 baseline -> average delta perplexity +0.9%, top1 generation acceptance down 0.7% on our commercial dev set. q4 options drop ~3.4% which is borderline. so q6_k looks acceptable for many infra-driven rollouts.

Anya P.: grooming notes: for latency-sensitive features keep H100 bs=1, but plan A100 reserved pools for steady throughput/cost when batched. also add driver rollout for EU-W H100 before enabling qkv-fused at scale.

Leo W.: any thermal throttling / sustained frequency issues observed on H100 over the 30m run?

Sam C.: short run (30m) — no thermal throttling alerts in US-W. EU-W had one transient throttle event correlating with degraded decode p95. Ops ticket created: INC-2026-182.

Talia R.: can you drop the per-route cost delta and suggested default? i can add to the model-onboard checklist.

Sam C.: suggested default config for now:
- rollout flag: model.mistral7b.q6_k.experimental=true
- region policy: prefer US-W H100 for low-latency <200ms p50 routes, fallback to A100 reserved for cost-bound batch endpoints
- kernel pinning: prefer qkv-fused-int8 when driver>=525.x, otherwise use safe fp16-decode
- monitor: eval-set perf regression >1.5% -> auto-rollback

Anya P.: awesome. can you attach raw logs and perf traces? will add to the onboarding PR. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: uploaded artifacts -> s3://redwood-ml-smoke/mistral7b/q6k/1728881234/ (profiles, flamegraphs, telemetry)

Sam C.: thanks — will queue a 4-hour sustained run tomorrow with updated drivers and a wider eval sweep.

Leo W.: +1. if EU-W drivers still flaky we should avoid enabling qkv fusion in EU for Canary.

Talia R.: noting action items: driver-update EU-W, 4h sustained run, attach eval diff to onboarding PR.

Sam C.: tagging @eng-ml for visibility. short smoke, but gives a clear story: H100 wins latency and per-core throughput, A100 still attractive for batched cost-efficiency. Q6_k is a reasonable trade for our eval set.

Anya P.: perfect. we'll use these numbers for the onboarding doc and cost calculator. :rocket:
